description: Flat stamped steel mounting bracket/strap with exactly three in-line holes: two plain holes and one serrated hole.

face.purpose: Authoritative front/back orientation rule shared by all checks that depend on face orientation.
face.decision_order: First establish front/back from the overall visible face geometry. Use the outer edge profile and the two plain-hole forms together. Do not use VA presence or absence to decide orientation.
face.front: Front is indicated by a chamfered/rolled outer edge and plain holes that are countersunk/dished. Either cue may be subtle; do not require a textbook-clear appearance of both cues.
face.back: Back is indicated by a square/sharp outer edge and plain holes that are flat through-holes. Either cue may be subtle; do not require a textbook-clear appearance of both cues.
face.lighting_tolerance: Lighting, reflection, viewing angle, and shallow countersinks can make a front-face cue look flatter or less pronounced. Judge the combined edge and plain-hole geometry rather than rejecting front solely because the countersink is subtle.
face.unresolved: Use only when the visible edge and plain-hole geometry is genuinely insufficient or contradictory for front/back orientation. Do not declare unresolved merely because one front/back cue is subtle.
face.for_dependent_checks: Once front is established, checks such as embossing_missing and incomplete_embossing may evaluate the VA. Once back is established, a blank VA is normal for those checks.

va.location: between the middle hole and the plain end-hole, on the side of the middle hole opposite the serrated hole
va.prerequisite: Before evaluating either embossing defect, establish front/back using the shared anatomy.face rules. Do not use VA presence or absence to determine orientation. Only inspect VA after the face orientation is established.

decision.check: Inspect the largest hole and determine whether the circumference of the bore/opening clearly has the required serrated/toothed pattern.
decision.defect_when: The required serrated/toothed pattern is not visibly present on the circumference of the largest hole.
decision.clear_when: One or more clearly visible sections of the circumference of the largest hole show the required serrated/toothed pattern. The full circumference does not need to be visible if the visible teeth clearly establish that the serration is present.
decision.review_when: Never use NEEDS_REVIEW for serration presence. If the required teeth cannot be clearly confirmed, treat serration as missing.
ignore: Damage or appearance inside the bore.
decision.boundary: Count only clearly visible teeth forming the serrated circumference of the largest hole. Teeth may be visible on only part of the circumference; a clear toothed pattern on a visible section is sufficient to establish that serration is present.
decision.localization: Tight box around the largest hole including the visible serrated circumference and bore.

decision.check: After the authoritative anatomy.face orientation rule establishes the front face, inspect the VA marking at its designated location.
decision.defect_when: Front is established by the shared anatomy.face rule, VA is present, and one or more required characters is visibly incomplete, partially formed, or clearly shallower/fainter than the other VA characters.
decision.clear_when: The front face is established, VA is clearly present, and all required characters are fully formed with consistent visible depth and definition; or the back face is established, where VA absence is normal.
decision.review_when: The shared face orientation cannot be reliably established, or after front is established the VA characters cannot be reliably judged because glare, shadow, dirt, blur, or insufficient resolution prevents comparison of their formation or depth.
ignore: A blank VA zone on the back face; this is normal.
Normal lighting variation that does not change the apparent character formation.
Minor visual variation that does not clearly indicate incomplete or shallow embossing.
decision.boundary: This defect is only evaluated on the confirmed front face. The shared VA orientation prerequisite must be satisfied first.
decision.localization: Tight box around the affected VA character or characters.

decision.check: After the authoritative anatomy.face orientation rule establishes the front face, inspect the VA zone at its designated location.
decision.defect_when: Front is established by the shared anatomy.face rule and the designated VA zone is blank or shows no visible VA embossing.
decision.clear_when: The back face is established and the VA zone is blank; or the front face is established and VA is visibly present.
decision.review_when: The shared face orientation cannot be reliably established.
ignore: A blank VA zone used by itself to infer the back face.
A subtle or visually flattened countersink/dish caused by lighting or viewing angle.
Glare, shadow or dirt mistaken for a missing mark.
decision.localization: Tight box around the designated VA zone when the front face is established and VA is missing.
decision.boundary: This defect is only evaluated on the confirmed front face. The shared VA orientation prerequisite must be satisfied first; on a confirmed back face, a blank VA zone is normal.
